nodes.label: Lightness Requirement
nodes.rationale: App runs continuously at ~15 MB footprint and 0% idle CPU; polling is strictly forbidden when event triggers (FileWatcher, NSWorkspace notifications, scheduled timers) exist.

nodes.label: Memcap Build Constraint
nodes.rationale: Swift builds must run capped under 2 GB via memcap to prevent excessive memory usage on a 16 GB Mac.

nodes.label: AppSettings Backward Compatibility
nodes.rationale: All new settings properties must decode tolerantly using decodeIfPresent ?? default in init(from:) to avoid invalidating legacy settings.

nodes.label: Non-Synthetic Testing Policy
nodes.rationale: Prohibits simulating clicks or keypresses to avoid interfering with full-screen user workflows; verification relies on AX inspection, targeted screencapture, logs, and footprint.

nodes.label: Notch Overflow Panel
nodes.rationale: The MacBook screen notch clips overflow items; rather than merely expanding the separator, items are displayed in a dropdown panel beneath the belt icon.

nodes.label: Non-activating Clipboard Panel
nodes.rationale: Using NSMenu with focus switching caused an ~1s delay when pasting; using a non-activating NSPanel maintains instant paste capability.

nodes.label: Screenshot Xattr Observation
nodes.rationale: NSMetadataQuery failed to return spotlight query results to the app; detecting screenshots is achieved by watching the screencapture folder and filtering on kMDItemIsScreenCapture.

nodes.label: Claude Usage Tracking
nodes.rationale: Reads cachedUsageUtilization directly from .claude.json via FileWatcher and scheduled reset timer, avoiding polling and undocumented endpoints.

nodes.label: WindowCatalog AX Traversal
nodes.rationale: Combines AX and _AXUIElementGetWindow with CGWindowList ordering; window focus via kAXFrontmostAttribute + AXRaise bypasses macOS 14 cooperative activation restrictions.
